notes.title: New Update
notes.content:
In response to a request we now have a view reset.
Click on the icon to the top right when in game and the view will reset.
If you hold the trigger down you can rotate/move to where you'd like to start from and then release the trigger.

notes.title: Quizality Gamers Edition update is now live
notes.content:
We have released our next update for Quizality:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27157772/c7d8d9d5976ae7e3454ac414277bad11f80cf363.png[/img]

There are now 3 new worlds to play which will test your videogame knowledge across all generations of games.

Generations 1 - 4 covers all 8 and 16 bit games, including arcade games.

Generations 5 & 6 covers the 32 bit era from the mid 1990's onwards.

Generations 7 & 8 covers all your recent favourites from the last 10 years or so.

Enjoy, and remember you need a VR headset to play Quizality.

notes.title: Updates
notes.content:
Hi,
     Whilst working on the game we've noticed a few issues which we wanted to push your way rather than waiting for the next major update.
      
These include -

Leaderboard now displays even if you haven't yet posted a score.

Vive controller no longer accepts multiple guesses on each question.

Achievements now correctly synched.

     cheers,
                  Roy

notes.title: Quizality is available now!
notes.content:
We are really excited to announce that Quizality is now available on Early Access, with a 30% discount for over the Christmas period.

Please give it a try and let us know what you think, and what you would like to see in future updates.

Merry Christmas/Happy Holidays from all of us at UV Games.
